name: Elden Ring Demake
storyline: In the Lands Between, a fallen Tarnished journeys across a ruined world in search of the Elden Ring. Guided by grace, they face powerful foe, the Omen Killer, in Liurnia, all in pursuit of becoming the Elden Lord.
summary:
Experience a PS1-inspired reimagining of Elden Ring in this fan-made demake. Battle the fearsome Omenkiller in a fast-paced Souls-like encounter, complete with retro visuals, nostalgic low-poly graphics, and classic PlayStation-era aesthetics.

Dodge, strike, and survive in this faithful recreation that captures the spirit of Elden Ring through the lens of a late '90s action game.
